field_note: Bridge blocked after heavy flooding. Around 40 people are isolated near the school. No clean water since yesterday. Road access unknown.
why_it_matters: Blocked access plus water shortage needs rapid verification and logistics routing.

field_note: Village school is being used as a temporary shelter. About 75 people arrived, including families with children. Need blankets, drinking water, and registration support.
why_it_matters: Shelter overload requires triage, registration, supplies, and human coordination.

field_note: Road partially covered by mud and rocks after landslide. One bus route blocked. No injuries reported yet. Need access assessment before sending supplies.
why_it_matters: Access-route uncertainty can delay relief unless routed to public works/search teams.

field_note: Smoke visible near the west edge of the village. Two elderly residents report breathing difficulty. Need evacuation guidance and confirmation whether road north is still open.
why_it_matters: The system must escalate without giving medical diagnosis or unsafe certainty.

field_note: Clinic has no insulin refrigeration after power failure. 18 patients registered. Backup generator not working. Need cold storage and licensed medical review.
why_it_matters: Health-related crisis reports need clear human medical review and supply routing.

field_note: Remote settlement reports no safe drinking water for two days. Message translated from local language. Approx 120 people. Road is passable by motorcycle only.
why_it_matters: Low-connectivity, multilingual reporting needs compact SMS and translated structured output.

field_note: Storm damaged roof of rural school. Classes suspended. No injuries. Need temporary learning space and safety inspection before reopening.
why_it_matters: Education continuity can be part of resilience after disasters.

field_note: Radio operator reports isolated neighborhood after flood. Unknown number of people, possible elderly residents, no photo available. Needs verification team.
why_it_matters: CrisisLens should handle sparse reports and explicitly request missing information.
